The population of the MSA is 2,106,616 according to 2016 census estimates, ranking second in Ohio, first solely in Ohio, and 33rd in the nation.
Canada 2016 Census | The Canada 2016 Census is a currently ongoing detailed enumeration of the Canadian population, ongoing as of May 2016.  The census, to be conducted by Statistics Canada is Canada's seventh quinquennial census.  Statistics Canada has identified May 10, 2016, as the official census day and census web access codes began arriving in the mail on May 2, 2016.  The 2016 census marked the reinstatement of the mandatory long-form census, which had been dropped in favour of the voluntary National Household Survey for the 2011 census.
Candelo, New South Wales | Candelo is a town in south-eastern New South Wales, Australia.  It is in the Bega Valley Shire local government area, 448 km south of the state capital, Sydney and 24 km north-west of the popular coastal holiday destination of Merimbula.  In 2011, Candelo had a population of 732 people.
